briefdescription.para: QRingInfo specialisation for quotients of polynomial rings over ZZ.

detaileddescription.para: Replaces the field-side MonomialTable with a MonomialTableZZ and tracks the is_ZZ_quotient_ / ZZ_quotient_value_ pair so that if the defining ideal contains a non-zero integer, coefficient reductions can be short-circuited modulo that integer. reduce_lead_term_ZZ drives both normal_form and gbvector_normal_form.
